THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT Aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 25.11.2019 passed in MVC No.199/2019 by the Court of XIV Addl.
Senior Civil Judge and Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bengaluru (SCCH-10) (for short 'the Tribunal'),

entities.text: Senior Civil Judge and Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: the petitioner therein has preferred this appeal.
2. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to herein as per their status before the Tribunal.

3. After arguing the matter for some time, learned counsel for the petitioner and respondent No.1-insurance company together submit that Court may enhance the compensation awarded by the Tribunal globally by Rs.75,000/- without any interest thereon.
Learned counsel for respondent No.1-insurance company has also filed a memo in this regard.
4. Memo is taken on record.

Hence, the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The petitioner is entitled to an enhanced compensation of Rs.75,000/- without any interest thereon over and above what has been already awarded by the Tribunal.
iii) Respondent No.1-insurance company shall pay the enhanced compensation to petitioner within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

iv) Draw modified award accordingly;
v) Registry to return the records to the jurisdictional Tribunal forthwith.

SD/-
